title: Measurement-enhanced entanglement in a monitored superconducting chain
summary: A common view in monitored quantum dynamics is that local measurements suppress entanglement growth. We show that this intuition can fail in a one-dimensional spinful fermionic chain governed by a BCS Hamiltonian with pairing strength $Δ$ and subject to continuous, on-site, spin-resolved charge measurements at rate $γ$. Using free-fermion simulations and quasiparticle analysis, we show that pairing suppresses entanglement growth, while measurements suppress pairing.
